Translations.runmode.settings.hardware.title: Hardware
Translations.runmode.settings.calibration.enabled.too: When calibration mode is enabled, all haptic feedback will be disabled and replaced with a calibration tone. Use this mode to test and configure your audio output system.
Translations.runmode.settings.hardware.calibration.fr: The frequency of the calibration tone. Use arrow keys or adjust to test different frequencies in your haptic systems response range.
Translations.runmode.settings.hardware.calibration.vo: The volume level of the calibration tone in decibels (0 dB is maximum output). Start with a low value and increase carefully while monitoring the output of the haptic system.
Translations.runmode.settings.hardware.calibration.hi: Adjust the frequency and volume to find the optimal settings for your haptic system. The calibration tone will play continuously while this mode is enabled.
Translations.runmode.settings.hardware.equalizer.tool: An 8-band parametric equalizer to adjust the frequency response of the synthesized audio signal. Avoid boosting values above zero as it can result in distortion and could damage your equipment. Instead try reducing stronger frequencies down to match the weaker frequencies.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.title: Haptics
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.dynamictransmis: The strength of gear change haptics can be fixed or dynamically scaled based on the acceleration of the vehicle to simulate the higher jerk that occurs during hard acceleration and braking. When set to fixed mode the feedback strength can be adjusted using the transmission gain control.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.transmissioncur: Compression curve applied to dynamic transmission feedback. Lower values apply more compression and high values approach a linear shape.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.gforcemax.toolt: The g-force value at which the dynamic transmission feedback reaches maximum scale.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.jerkcurve.toolt: Compression curve applied to the strength of chassis haptic feedback. Lower values apply more compression and high values approach a linear shape.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.jerkmax.tooltip: The maximum value where chassis haptic feedback reaches maximum strength.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.snapcurve.toolt: Compression curve applied to the frequency of chassis haptic feedback. Lower values apply more compression and high values approach a linear shape.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.snapmax.tooltip: The maximum value where chassis haptic feedback reaches maximum frequency.
The maximum output volume allowed to be produced between 0.0 (mute) and 1.0 (max). Generally this can be left at the default value of 1
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.pulseminfreq.to: The minimum frequency that should be output for haptic feedback. Values lower than ~10 Hz may be difficult to perceive.
Translations.runmode.settings.haptics.pulsemaxfreq.to: The maximum frequency that should be output for haptic feedback. Values higher than ~60 Hz may be difficult to perceive.
Translations.runmode.settings.pitradio.title: Pit Radio
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.title: Synthesizer
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.internalsamplerat: The sample rate for the computed haptic signal. A value of 8 kHz is more than sufficient for the haptic range and will consume less CPU resources than higher values.
The haptic signal can be efficiently resampled to higher rates for audio chipsets that do not support the lower internal sample rate. Many chipsets support only 32 kHz or higher so adjust this setting accordingly.
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.mastergain.toolti: Controls the overall output gain (strength) of the haptic feedback. The range is -60 dB (silent) to 0 dB (loudest).
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.chassisgain.toolt: Controls the strength of chassis vibration effects.
Controls the strength of transmission feedback effects.
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.transmissiongainm: Minimum transmission gain for race vehicles. This value is the output strength when the vehicle is stopped and very low acceleration rates.
Minimum transmission gain for street vehicles. This value is the output strength when the vehicle is stopped and very low acceleration rates.
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.enginegain.toolti: Controls the strength of engine vibration effects.
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.gainincrement.too: The increment dB step size used when adjusting gain values using UI buttons.
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.primarybalance.to: Primary balance of the engine (0.0 = unbalanced, 1.0 = perfectly balanced). Affects the fundamental vibration character.
Secondary balance of the engine (0.0 = unbalanced, 1.0 = perfectly balanced). Affects harmonic vibrations. Note that this setting doesn't currently have any noticeable effect.
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.engineprofilegain: Additional gain offset applied to this engine profile. Use negative values to reduce intensity.
Translations.runmode.settings.synth.pulsescale.toolti: Scales the pulse rate (1.0 = normal, <1.0 = reduced rate). Useful for high-RPM or multi-cylinder engines to keep feedback in the tactile range.
Translations.runmode.settings.telemetry.source.toolti: Accepts a UDP address in the format udp://<ip_address>:<port> or a replay file path in the format file://path/to/replay.<gtr|gtz>. Use the Auto button to automatically connect to GT7 running on the local network.
